summary: Integrate Luna bit-field insertion and retain the unfinished logic pilot with exact review, effort and replay evidence.

examined.reason: Exact third Luna candidate accepted after universal/concrete drivers, fresh replay and separate source/statement inspection. Bit-vector computation masks both position and length; all operand patterns retained.
Remains unimplemented: final candidate does not compile in the bit-observation and decoder proofs. Exact obligations retained; no weakening or integration.
One accepted selected form added with exact source, worker patch and replay evidence; fixed the stale prose enumeration of prior forms and added the new form to regression expectations.
Pilot delegates computation bodies under fixed all-input bit laws, reports substantial preflight/proof guidance and includes both success and failure without a productivity-improvement claim.
Frozen four-case fixture and separate candidate reviews recorded; two reviewer explanation errors adjudicated. A real 600-second deadline failure has no verdict or known billing.
Insertion uses existing Pure32 relation and typed execution adapters; no shared foundation change.
Catalog extension preserves family results directly and its functional theorem rechecks; generic nonfunctional catalogs still permit multiple results.
Existing example program, proof statements and computation are unchanged.
Existing arbitrary-length array example and termination results unchanged; rechecked under extended catalog.
No change to scalar state, instructions, memory steps or execution rules.
Audit gains entries only; no concurrent semantics or proofs changed.
Single-thread selected insertion does not extend memory, concurrency, raw-module or hardware claims.
Section inventory remains unassessed; 23 selected forms do not imply section coverage.
Proof validity, source fidelity, model opinions and hardware evidence remain separate; reviewer mistakes and unfinished proofs disclosed.

results.method: Core project check, BFI universal/concrete drivers, Lean reviewer adjudication, array example, TorchLean integration, exact candidate-hash verification, distribution guard, Stratic validation and source/proof/provenance review. Final documentation-only delta separately revalidated.
results.environment: Linux; pinned Lean 4.34.0; local pinned PTX ISA 9.4 source; Python regression suites; no model calls during final verification.
results.evidence: Core passed on tree 940821aac573c492fbfe171b90a400713afb2288: 1535 dependency reports, only standard Lean axioms; 23 accepted forms; 1269 archive members across 16 archives; 106 worker tests, 26 ledger tests and 7 inventory tests. BFI unchanged worker source hash equals reviewed candidate recipe; its universal/concrete drivers pass, as do reviewer counterexample adjudication and the array example. TorchLean integration passed with 363 dependency reports. Final tree differs only in the accepted-form guide and Stratic prose/metadata: count/list updated, BFI added and reversal feature-floor wording corrected to SM20, consistent with existing implementation and ledger. No checked code, contract, script or evidence changed. Final Stratic, ledger and whitespace checks pass. Manual inspection preserves all-input semantics and guards/target/decoder boundaries. LOP3 remains intentionally unimplemented; archived failure is not an acceptance. Both LOP3 reviews lacked usable verdicts; the real deadline had unknown billing. No manual/vendor raw transcripts distributed.
